environment.description: Same container image deployed on ECS Fargate. Task definition includes a custom seccomp profile loaded via ECS task definition securityContext (dockerSecurityOpt) that restricts the clone, execve, and execveat syscalls to a specific allowlist of binaries via arg-inspection BPF filters — only /usr/bin/convert with argv[0] matching 'convert' is permitted to spawn. Additionally, the ImageMagick policy.xml has been modified: the <policy domain='coder' rights='none' pattern='MSL' />, <policy domain='coder' rights='none' pattern='MVG' />, <policy domain='coder' rights='none' pattern='EPHEMERAL' />, <policy domain='coder' rights='none' pattern='URL' />, <policy domain='coder' rights='none' pattern='HTTPS' />, <policy domain='coder' rights='none' pattern='HTTP' />, and <policy domain='delegate' rights='none' pattern='*' /> entries are all present, disabling all delegate execution and network-capable coders. The container also runs with read-only root filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true) with only /tmp mounted as a tmpfs with noexec,nosuid,nodev flags.

config.seccomp_profile: custom BPF filter restricting execve/execveat to allowlisted binary paths (/usr/bin/convert only)
config.imagemagick_policy: policy.xml with rights='none' for MSL, MVG, EPHEMERAL, URL, HTTPS, HTTP coders and all delegates disabled
config.filesystem: readonlyRootFilesystem: true, /tmp as tmpfs with noexec,nosuid,nodev
